population.label: Population
population.definition: The size, composition, distribution and movement of human populations and their vital events.
includes: Population and household counts, demographic characteristics and vital statistics.
Migration and the demographic circumstances of resident communities.
excludes: Use the subject topic for workers, patients or pupils counted only as participants in an institution or activity.
A place or ethnic label alone does not make an unrelated economic table demographic.

government.label: Government
government.definition: The institutions, personnel, territorial organization and legal foundations through which public authority is exercised.
includes: Central and local administration, political institutions, elections and public officials.
Constitutions, laws, administrative jurisdictions and official status.
excludes: Government ownership or provision alone: use the substantive topic for state factories, hospitals or schools.
Public revenue, expenditure and debt without administrative substance belong under finance.

informal-imperialism.label: Informal imperialism
informal-imperialism.definition: Foreign power exercised through unequal privileges, jurisdiction, strategic footholds or control without formal incorporation into the ruling power’s colonial administration.
includes: Foreign concessions, treaty-port privileges, extraterritorial jurisdiction and foreign garrisons.
Documented foreign direction of a nominally sovereign state or its institutions.
excludes: Formal colonial government, annexed possessions, protectorates, mandates and formally administered colonial leased territories: use colonial-rule.
Foreign trade, investment, migration or observations about Manchoukuo do not establish imperial control by themselves.

colonial-rule.label: Colonial rule
colonial-rule.definition: Formal political rule over annexed territories, colonies, protectorates, mandates or colonial territories administered under lease.
includes: Colonial governing institutions and the establishment or change of formal colonial status.
Settlement, assimilation or resistance when colonial rule itself is a substantive subject.
excludes: Unequal foreign privileges or external control in nominally sovereign territory without formal colonial administration: use informal-imperialism.
Statistics about a colony’s crops, population or schools without substantive evidence about colonial power: use their subject topics.

indigenous-peoples.label: Indigenous peoples
indigenous-peoples.definition: Indigenous communities, their societies, livelihoods and relationships with governing authorities.
includes: Identified indigenous peoples as the substantive subject, including historical accounts and community statistics.
Policies, frontier control and institutions specifically directed at indigenous communities.
excludes: Do not classify every ethnic minority or every historically named tribe as indigenous solely from a label.
A geographic location associated with indigenous peoples does not justify the topic for unrelated production or infrastructure.

foreign-relations.label: Foreign relations
foreign-relations.definition: Official relations between states and their participation in international institutions.
includes: Diplomacy, recognition, treaties, international negotiations and interstate disputes.
Diplomatic and consular missions and international organizations.
excludes: Cross-border trade, finance or migration without diplomatic or interstate substance.
A foreign nationality or country comparison alone.

military.label: Military
military.definition: Armed forces, warfare, defence organization and preparation for or conduct of military operations.
includes: Service branches, equipment, recruitment, defence institutions and military operations.
Military mobilisation, casualties and civil air-defence arrangements.
excludes: Civilian aviation, shipping or manufacturing without an explicit defence purpose.
Ordinary police work and criminal cases without military participation or purpose.

crime-and-justice.label: Crime and justice
crime-and-justice.definition: Law enforcement, judicial proceedings, offences, punishment and the administration of justice.
includes: Police, courts, criminal and civil proceedings, detention and correctional institutions.
Illegal trade, regulated sex work and coercive enforcement when these are the substantive subject.
excludes: An activity is not a justice subject merely because it is regulated by law.
Constitutions and legislative organization without adjudication or enforcement belong under government.

narcotics.label: Narcotics
narcotics.definition: Opium and other narcotic drugs: their production, distribution, use, control and treatment of dependence.
includes: Poppy cultivation, narcotic trade, state monopolies, licensing and suppression.
Drug consumption, dependence and services treating narcotic addiction.
excludes: Alcohol and tobacco unless the table substantively addresses a narcotic alongside them.
General medicines, pharmacy or medical services without a narcotic subject.

health.label: Health
health.definition: Human or animal health, disease prevention, medical care and the conditions affecting health.
includes: Disease, mortality by health cause, medical personnel and institutions, preventive services and sanitation.
Nutrition, maternal and child health, mental health, veterinary health and pharmaceuticals.
excludes: Population totals or births and deaths without a health measure or cause do not require health.
Water infrastructure, food output or welfare services without substantive health content use their own topics.

welfare.label: Welfare
welfare.definition: Living conditions and organized support for people facing poverty, dependency, displacement or other social needs.
includes: Relief, charitable institutions, child and family support, housing and household living standards.
Support for refugees, veterans and military families and work-relief schemes.
excludes: Ordinary wages, employment or commercial finance without a living-standard or support measure.
Medical treatment and education alone belong under health or education.

population-totals.label: population totals
population-totals.definition: Counts, estimates or density of the total resident population of a place.
includes: Censuses, population estimates, urban and rural totals, and comparative population density.
excludes: Counts of employees, patients, pupils or passengers without a population denominator or demographic purpose.

age-and-sex.label: age and sex
age-and-sex.definition: The distribution or demographic characteristics of people by age or sex.
includes: Age groups, sex ratios, age pyramids and demographic tables cross-classified by age or sex.
excludes: Age or sex appearing only as a minor label in an otherwise unrelated institutional table.

households.label: households
households.definition: The number, size, composition or demographic circumstances of households and families.
includes: Household counts, persons per household, family composition and household demographic comparisons.
excludes: Household expenditure without household-demographic content: use household-budgets.
The administration of household registers: use household-registration.

births-and-deaths.label: births and deaths
births-and-deaths.definition: The occurrence, number or rate of births, stillbirths and deaths.
includes: Vital statistics, natural increase, fertility, death rates and stillbirths.
excludes: Age composition alone; use infant-mortality or a named health tag when the table’s focus is more specific.

marriage-and-divorce.label: marriage and divorce
marriage-and-divorce.definition: The formation and dissolution of marriages and people’s marital status.
includes: Marriage and divorce counts or rates, marriage age and marital-status distributions.
excludes: Family size alone; judicial divorce procedure without marriage or divorce outcomes.

migration.label: migration
migration.definition: Movement of people that changes their usual residence or records a recurring labour or settlement flow.
includes: Immigration, emigration, internal migration and seasonal migrant-worker arrivals and departures.
excludes: Passenger traffic, port landings and departures that do not establish migration.
Use settler-migration when settlement associated with colonial expansion or foreign state sponsorship is the evidenced specific subject.

nationality-and-ethnicity.label: nationality and ethnicity
nationality-and-ethnicity.definition: The composition or characteristics of people by nationality, ethnicity or the source’s racial classifications.
includes: Residents or migrant populations classified by nationality, citizenship, ethnic community or historically used racial categories.
excludes: The nationality of ships, trading partners or companies without a human-population subject.
Do not infer ethnicity from language, location or a publisher’s political claims.

occupations.label: occupations
occupations.definition: The distribution or classification of people by occupation, calling or livelihood.
includes: Population by profession, trade, occupational class or principal livelihood.
excludes: Wage levels, working hours or enterprise output without occupational-composition content.

languages.label: languages
languages.definition: Languages spoken or used by populations, communities or public services.
includes: Linguistic distribution, mother tongues, language use and services classified by language.
excludes: Language teaching or school curricula alone: use language-education.
The language in which a table is printed.

overseas-communities.label: overseas communities
overseas-communities.definition: Communities living outside their place of national or ethnic origin and their collective institutions or circumstances.
includes: Overseas residents, diaspora communities and their associations, schools or local distribution when the community is the subject.
excludes: Migration flows alone; foreign trade by country; automatically treating every overseas resident as a colonial settler.

household-registration.label: household registration
household-registration.definition: Systems and records that officially register households, family membership or changes in civil status.
includes: Household registers, registration offices, registered persons and entries or changes in civil registers.
excludes: Household totals from a census without a registration-system subject.

suicide.label: suicide
suicide.definition: Intentional self-inflicted deaths and recorded attempts to take one’s own life.
includes: Suicide totals and rates and their distribution by method, age, sex or recorded cause.
excludes: All-cause mortality; mental illness without suicidal behaviour; accidental deaths; self-injury without suicidal intent.

infant-mortality.label: infant mortality
infant-mortality.definition: Deaths or survival rates of infants, ordinarily before their first birthday.
includes: Infant and neonatal death counts, mortality rates and comparisons of infant survival.
excludes: Stillbirths counted separately by the source; deaths of older children without an infant measure.

government-offices.label: government offices
government-offices.definition: Public administrative bodies, their functions, officeholders and civil-service personnel.
includes: Ministries, boards, administrative organization, official appointments, staffing and civil-service salaries or allowances.
excludes: The activity of a public hospital, school or enterprise when administrative organization is incidental.
Use local-government for specifically local governing institutions.

elections-and-parties.label: elections and parties
elections-and-parties.definition: Electoral systems, voting, political parties and representative political organization.
includes: Franchise, electors, election results, party membership and elected assemblies or party organizations.
excludes: Appointments to a ministry without an electoral or party subject.

local-government.label: local government
local-government.definition: The institutions, personnel and administration of subnational governing authorities.
includes: Municipal, provincial, prefectural, county, district, village or banner government and local councils.
excludes: Local population or production alone; lists of territorial units without governing functions use administrative-divisions.

imperial-household.label: imperial household
imperial-household.definition: The reigning emperor or monarch, royal family, court and institutions or property attached to the royal household.
includes: Royal genealogies, succession, court officials, household organization and crown estates as royal property.
excludes: The whole empire merely because it has an emperor; ordinary government institutions unrelated to the court.

honours-and-ranks.label: honours and ranks
honours-and-ranks.definition: Official decorations, honours, precedence and civil or military status ranks.
includes: Orders, medals, recipients of honours, rank systems and officials classified by rank.
excludes: Salary tables without a substantive rank structure; a numbered list or league ranking.

constitutions-and-laws.label: constitutions and laws
constitutions-and-laws.definition: Constitutional arrangements, legislation and legal rules treated as texts, frameworks or legislative outputs.
includes: Constitutions, promulgated laws, legal reforms, law lists and the content or scope of statutes and regulations.
excludes: A statistical activity merely operating under a law; court case outcomes without a substantive legal-framework subject.

administrative-divisions.label: administrative divisions
administrative-divisions.definition: Territorial units, boundaries and jurisdictions used to organize government.
includes: Provinces, prefectures, counties, municipalities, banners and changes to their administrative boundaries or status.
excludes: Physical landforms and area alone; activity totals merely grouped by province.

passports-and-travel-permits.label: passports and travel permits
passports-and-travel-permits.definition: Official documents and permissions authorizing travel, entry, exit or residence.
includes: Passports, visas, travel passes, permits and their issue, refusal or administration.
excludes: Migration totals without a documentary-permission subject; ordinary travel timetables or fares.

foreign-concessions.label: foreign concessions
foreign-concessions.definition: Territorial concessions or foreign-administered settlements granted through unequal arrangements in a nominally sovereign state.
includes: Foreign settlements, concession governments, special foreign rights and their geographic or institutional extent.
excludes: Ordinary commercial contracts or mining licences; formal colonial administration of annexed or colonial leased territories.

extraterritoriality.label: extraterritoriality
extraterritoriality.definition: Exemption from local jurisdiction through foreign or consular legal authority.
includes: Consular courts, foreign jurisdiction, nationality-based legal privilege and its abolition or transfer.
excludes: Ordinary overseas diplomacy; court systems without foreign-jurisdiction privileges.

treaty-ports.label: treaty ports
treaty-ports.definition: Ports opened to foreign residence or commerce under a treaty-created system of special rights.
includes: Treaty-port status, opening agreements, institutions and port comparisons explicitly organized around that system.
excludes: Cargo or vessel totals for an ordinary port; a port’s treaty history does not make all its later trade tables treaty-port tables.

foreign-garrisons.label: foreign garrisons
foreign-garrisons.definition: Foreign armed forces stationed in another nominally sovereign territory under special rights or unequal power arrangements.
includes: Foreign troop stations, garrison privileges, deployment and support of such foreign forces.
excludes: A state’s ordinary home garrisons; colonial forces where formal colonial administration is the subject.

annexation-and-protectorates.label: annexation and protectorates
annexation-and-protectorates.definition: The establishment, terms or termination of annexation or formal protectorate status.
includes: Annexation agreements, protectorate treaties, transfers of sovereignty and changes in formal dependency.
excludes: A declaration of statehood or diplomatic recognition without annexation or protectorate status.
Foreign economic influence without a formal status change.

colonial-administration.label: colonial administration
colonial-administration.definition: The governing machinery, powers and practices of formally administered colonial territories.
includes: Governors-general, colonial departments, mandated administration, colonial legal regimes and administration of colonial leased territories.
excludes: An ordinary administrative table in a nominally sovereign state without formal colonial jurisdiction.
Production or social observations in a colony when the governing relationship is incidental.

settler-migration.label: settler migration
settler-migration.definition: Organized settlement migration associated with colonial expansion or foreign state-sponsored settlement projects.
includes: Settler groups, settlement locations, pioneer schemes, settler subsidies and their land or demographic circumstances.
excludes: Ordinary migrant labour or overseas residents without an evidenced settlement scheme.
A settler table does not by itself establish that its territory was formally colonized.

assimilation-policies.label: assimilation policies
assimilation-policies.definition: Policies intended to remake a subject community’s language, identity, customs or social institutions to conform to a ruling group.
includes: Explicit assimilation programmes, compulsory identity or language changes and related institutions.
excludes: Japanese-language schools, religious institutions or cultural change without evidence of an assimilation policy.

independence-movements.label: independence movements
independence-movements.definition: Collective political action seeking self-rule or freedom from colonial or dependent status.
includes: Independence organizations, anti-colonial campaigns, self-government movements and documented resistance pursuing sovereignty.
excludes: Official founding declarations or recognition of a new regime without a popular or organized independence movement.
Criminal or armed groups whose political purpose is not established.

frontier-policing.label: frontier policing
frontier-policing.definition: Policing and coercive control of frontier areas or indigenous communities.
includes: Frontier police, expeditions described as pacification, security posts and enforcement directed at indigenous areas.
excludes: Ordinary urban policing; every military campaign or border dispute; an indigenous location without policing content.

guard-lines.label: guard lines
guard-lines.definition: Guarded barriers or lines of posts used to control access, movement or territory along an indigenous or colonial frontier.
includes: Guard lines, barrier posts, frontier cordons and their staffing, length, costs or extension.
excludes: Railway guards, ordinary border stations or historic walls unless their frontier-control function is the subject.

diplomatic-service.label: diplomatic service
diplomatic-service.definition: Diplomatic and consular missions, representatives and the official services that conduct foreign relations.
includes: Embassies, legations, consulates, ambassadors, consular officers and establishments abroad.
excludes: Foreign residents or traders without an official diplomatic role; interstate agreements without service or mission content.

treaties.label: treaties
treaties.definition: Formal agreements between states and the negotiation, operation or termination of those agreements.
includes: Treaties, protocols, interstate conventions, trade or navigation agreements and treaty-text indexes.
excludes: Private commercial agreements; a trade table that merely concerns countries with a treaty.

international-organisations.label: international organisations
international-organisations.definition: Intergovernmental or international coordinating institutions, their membership, proceedings and activities.
includes: The League of Nations, international commissions and conferences functioning as institutions, and participation or withdrawal.
excludes: Any foreign company or domestic association; a single bilateral treaty without an international institution.

army.label: army
army.definition: Land armed forces, their organization, personnel, units and military activities.
includes: Army formations, land-force stations, standing armies and army-specific equipment or expenditure.
excludes: Ordinary civilian police; naval or air forces unless army aviation is explicitly part of the land service.

navy.label: navy
navy.definition: Naval forces and their personnel, warships, bases and operations.
includes: Fleet organization, naval stations, gunboats, naval aviation and navy-specific expenditure.
excludes: Merchant shipping, civilian ports or commercial shipbuilding without naval content.

war-and-mobilisation.label: war and mobilisation
war-and-mobilisation.definition: Warfare, military campaigns and the mobilisation of people or resources for conflict.
includes: War operations, military incidents, requisition, wartime mobilisation laws and conflict-specific expenditure or losses.
excludes: Peacetime organization alone; ordinary economic plans without an explicit war or defence purpose.

air-force.label: air force
air-force.definition: Military aviation forces, their organization, aircraft, personnel and operations.
includes: Air units, military air bases, armed-service aviation and military aircraft strength.
excludes: Civil airlines, civil aircraft manufacture or civil airfields without military use as a substantive subject.

arms-and-arsenals.label: arms and arsenals
arms-and-arsenals.definition: Weapons, ammunition, military equipment and the facilities that produce or store them.
includes: Munitions, arsenals, arms manufacture, military stocks and captured weapons.
excludes: Industrial machinery, chemicals or explosives whose military use is not evidenced.

military-casualties.label: military casualties
military-casualties.definition: Deaths, wounds, missing personnel or other human casualties attributed to military service or operations.
includes: Battle casualties, forces’ losses and civilians explicitly enumerated as casualties of military conflict.
excludes: All-cause population deaths; property damage; ordinary crime victims without a military-operation connection.

recruitment-and-conscription.label: recruitment and conscription
recruitment-and-conscription.definition: The enlistment, compulsory recruitment or selection of personnel for military service.
includes: Conscription systems, recruits, examinations, exemptions, reserve call-ups and enlistment.
excludes: Total serving personnel without recruitment content; civilian employment placement.

air-defence.label: air defence
air-defence.definition: Measures to detect, deter or protect people and infrastructure against aerial attack.
includes: Air-raid precautions, warning systems, shelters, anti-aircraft defence and civil defence specifically against air attack.
excludes: Routine aviation safety, general firefighting or weather warnings.

police.label: police
police.definition: Civil law-enforcement institutions, personnel, organization and routine activities.
includes: Police offices, stations, officers, water police, arrests and policing expenditure or jurisdiction.
excludes: Military organization alone; judicial proceedings after referral to court.

courts.label: courts
courts.definition: Courts, prosecutorial institutions, their jurisdictions, staff and judicial business.
includes: Judicial organization, procurators, court officials, trials, court workloads and case dispositions.
excludes: Police activity without adjudication; legal texts without courts or proceedings.

offences-and-convictions.label: offences and convictions
offences-and-convictions.definition: Recorded crimes, suspects, prosecutions, convictions and criminal penalties or outcomes.
includes: Offence categories, criminal case totals, arrests by offence, convicted persons and sentences.
excludes: Civil lawsuits; general police staffing; political character of an offence inferred only from the regime.

prisons.label: prisons
prisons.definition: Detention and correctional institutions and the people held in them.
includes: Prison locations, capacity, inmates, admissions, releases, prison administration and inmate conditions.
excludes: Police arrests without detention information; post-release aid alone.

smuggling.label: smuggling
smuggling.definition: The unlawful movement of goods across customs, tax or other controlled boundaries.
includes: Contraband, seizures, smuggling offences and suppression of illicit cross-border trade.
excludes: Legal imports and exports; ordinary customs receipts or tariffs.

piracy.label: piracy
piracy.definition: Robbery, violent seizure or raiding directed at vessels or traffic on sea or inland waters.
includes: Pirate attacks, river piracy, suppression and losses explicitly identified as piracy.
excludes: Banditry without a waterborne attack; naval warfare; legal shipping traffic.

sex-work.label: sex work
sex-work.definition: Commercial sexual services and the people, premises and regulatory institutions associated with them.
includes: Licensed or unlicensed prostitution, brothels, workers, registration and related inspections.
excludes: Marriage statistics; venereal disease totals without a sex-work population or setting.

political-policing.label: political policing
political-policing.definition: Police surveillance, investigation and repression of political beliefs, organizations or dissent.
includes: Political arrests, security policing, surveillance and enforcement against political activity.
excludes: Ordinary crime enforcement; assume no political motive from an offence label alone.
Publication suppression without policing content can use censorship.

summary-justice.label: summary justice
summary-justice.definition: Judicial or police disposal of cases through simplified or administrative procedures outside ordinary full trials.
includes: Summary trials, police adjudication, immediate dispositions and summary penalties.
excludes: A summary statistical table about ordinary court cases; all convictions or punishments.

civil-litigation.label: civil litigation
civil-litigation.definition: Court proceedings over private rights, obligations and non-criminal disputes.
includes: Civil suits, civil judgments, litigation over property, debt, contracts and family rights.
excludes: Criminal prosecutions; property registration without a dispute; private arbitration without court litigation.

land-registration.label: land registration
land-registration.definition: Legal registration of land ownership, title and other rights in real property.
includes: Land registers, deeds, title transfers, registered mortgages and cadastral records used to establish legal rights.
excludes: Physical land surveys alone; cultivated area or land tenure without registration.

prison-labour.label: prison labour
prison-labour.definition: Work performed by detained or sentenced people and its organization or economic results.
includes: Prison industries, inmate employment, penal labour, output, earnings and working arrangements.
excludes: Ordinary factory labour; forced work outside a penal or detention setting unless a prison connection is explicit.

juvenile-justice.label: juvenile justice
juvenile-justice.definition: Law enforcement and judicial or correctional treatment specifically involving young offenders.
includes: Juvenile offences, youth courts, reformatories, probation and correctional education for offenders.
excludes: Child welfare, ordinary schooling or youth organizations without a justice purpose.

prisoner-aftercare.label: prisoner aftercare
prisoner-aftercare.definition: Support and supervision intended to reintegrate people after release from detention or punishment.
includes: Discharged-prisoner aid, aftercare organizations, post-release employment help and reintegration services.
excludes: Care of current inmates; general poverty relief without a released-prisoner population.

corporal-punishment.label: corporal punishment
corporal-punishment.definition: Punishment deliberately inflicted on the body, such as flogging or caning.
includes: Corporal sentences, recipients and regulations or administration of physical disciplinary punishment.
excludes: Imprisonment, fines, capital punishment, military casualties or injury statistics without corporal punishment.

mediation-and-arbitration.label: mediation and arbitration
mediation-and-arbitration.definition: Resolution of disputes by a mediator or arbitrator rather than an ordinary judicial judgment.
includes: Mediation panels, conciliation cases, arbitration proceedings and settlements, including labour disputes.
excludes: Ordinary civil or criminal trials; interstate negotiations without a mediation or arbitration mechanism.

opium.label: opium
opium.definition: Opium, poppy cultivation for opium and the production, distribution or use of opium.
includes: Poppy-growing areas, opium purchases and sales, trade, smoking, revenue and opium-control systems.
excludes: Other narcotics without an opium component; ordinary pharmaceutical totals.

morphine-and-heroin.label: morphine and heroin
morphine-and-heroin.definition: Morphine and heroin as named narcotic substances, including their production, trade, use and control.
includes: Morphine or heroin quantities, seizures, consumption, manufacture and regulation.
excludes: Opium alone; medicines or narcotics in aggregate without either named substance.

drug-suppression.label: drug suppression
drug-suppression.definition: Measures to prevent, prohibit or enforce restrictions on narcotic production, trade or use.
includes: Anti-drug campaigns, seizures, destruction of poppy crops, illicit-trade enforcement and suppression results.
excludes: Lawful state purchases or licensing alone; treatment of addiction without a suppression programme.

opium-licensing.label: opium licensing
opium-licensing.definition: Official permission and registration systems regulating opium cultivation, sale, supply or smoking.
includes: Licensed growing areas, opium sellers, registered smokers and issue or withdrawal of smoking certificates.
excludes: Illicit seizures alone; drug consumption totals without a licensing or registration component.

drug-consumption.label: drug consumption
drug-consumption.definition: The extent, pattern or circumstances of narcotic use and dependence in a population.
includes: Drug users, smoking quantities, consumption rates, addicts and patterns of narcotic dependence.
excludes: Production or trade quantities without evidence of use; counts of treatment facilities without consumption or dependence measures.

medical-services.label: medical services
medical-services.definition: The provision, organization, personnel and use of medical or dental care.
includes: Hospitals, clinics, physicians, dentists, nurses, medical capacity, patients treated and service costs.
excludes: Medical-school enrolment alone; disease incidence without a care-service measure; medical goods alone.

diseases.label: diseases
diseases.definition: The occurrence, distribution, causes or outcomes of named or classified illnesses.
includes: Morbidity, disease-specific deaths, notifiable diseases and patients classified by diagnosis.
excludes: All-cause deaths without disease information; hospital staffing alone; an epidemic label without evidence of an outbreak.

public-health.label: public health
public-health.definition: Collective measures and institutions protecting population health and improving sanitary conditions.
includes: Health administration, sanitation, hygiene, disease prevention, health inspection and environmental health.
excludes: General utility capacity or construction without a health or sanitation purpose; individual clinical care alone.

nutrition.label: nutrition
nutrition.definition: Diet, nutritional intake and the adequacy or health effects of food consumption.
includes: Dietary composition, calories, nutrient intake, malnutrition and nutrition programmes.
excludes: Crop output, food trade, ration quantities or household food spending without nutritional content.

epidemics.label: epidemics
epidemics.definition: Outbreaks or exceptional spread of infectious disease and organized responses to them.
includes: Epidemic episodes, outbreak mortality, transmission patterns and epidemic-control campaigns.
excludes: Routine infectious-disease counts without outbreak or epidemic evidence; every case of a contagious disease.

quarantine.label: quarantine
quarantine.definition: Restriction, inspection or isolation intended to prevent disease crossing a boundary or spreading from exposed persons, animals or goods.
includes: Port health checks, quarantine stations, inspected travellers or vessels and isolation measures.
excludes: Ordinary customs inspection, immigration documentation or disease treatment without quarantine.

maternal-and-child-health.label: maternal and child health
maternal-and-child-health.definition: Health conditions and medical or preventive services specifically concerning mothers, pregnancy, childbirth or children.
includes: Maternity services, midwifery, maternal mortality, infant clinics and child-health programmes.
excludes: Birth counts alone; general child welfare or schooling without a health subject.

pharmaceuticals.label: pharmaceuticals
pharmaceuticals.definition: Medicines, their preparation, supply, regulation and pharmaceutical personnel or establishments.
includes: Medicinal drugs, pharmacies, pharmacists, drug manufacture, pharmaceutical imports and quality control.
excludes: General chemical output; opium or other narcotics when only narcotic control or use is discussed.

vaccination.label: vaccination
vaccination.definition: Administration and organization of vaccines or comparable immunization programmes.
includes: Vaccinations, vaccinated persons, vaccine supply and campaigns against specified diseases.
excludes: Other disease treatments, quarantine or general prevention without immunization.

leprosy.label: leprosy
leprosy.definition: Leprosy and the institutions, policies and services specifically directed at people affected by it.
includes: Leprosy cases, leprosaria, segregation policies, treatment and patient populations.
excludes: General infectious-disease tables without a substantive leprosy measure.

veterinary-health.label: veterinary health
veterinary-health.definition: The health of animals and services preventing or treating animal disease.
includes: Animal disease, veterinary staff, animal-health laboratories, vaccination, inspections and epizootics.
excludes: Livestock numbers, breeding, slaughter output or meat production without animal-health content.

malaria.label: malaria
malaria.definition: Malaria, its incidence and the measures or services intended to prevent or treat it.
includes: Malaria cases and deaths, mosquito-control programmes explicitly against malaria and malaria treatment.
excludes: Other fevers or general sanitation without an explicit malaria connection.

mental-health.label: mental health
mental-health.definition: Mental illness, psychological health and institutions or services providing psychiatric care.
includes: Psychiatric patients, mental hospitals, mental-health diagnoses and care.
excludes: Suicide totals without mental-health evidence; drug use or dependence without psychiatric care or diagnosis.

food-inspection.label: food inspection
food-inspection.definition: Inspection, testing or regulation of food safety and the sanitary fitness of food for consumption.
includes: Food and drink inspections, adulteration, slaughterhouse sanitary checks and condemned food.
excludes: Food quantities, commodity standards or trade classification without a health-safety inspection purpose.

poor-relief.label: poor relief
poor-relief.definition: Material aid and services directed at people unable to meet basic needs.
includes: Poor relief recipients, expenditure, almshouses, subsistence aid and support in cash or kind.
excludes: Poverty measurements without an assistance programme; ordinary wages or loans.

child-welfare.label: child welfare
child-welfare.definition: Support and protection for children and dependent young people outside ordinary schooling or clinical care.
includes: Orphanages, child protection, foster care, childcare and support for dependent children.
excludes: School attendance or child-health services alone; juvenile punishment without a welfare-service subject.

housing.label: housing
housing.definition: Residential accommodation, housing conditions and the provision or support of dwellings.
includes: Dwelling supply, rents, overcrowding, worker housing, public housing and housing assistance.
excludes: Household counts without dwelling information; general construction output or urban planning without a housing subject.

household-budgets.label: household budgets
household-budgets.definition: Observed income, expenditure, consumption and savings budgets of households or families.
includes: Family income/expenditure surveys, actual spending baskets, consumption and household savings.
excludes: Business accounts or public budgets; isolated living-cost indices without observed family budgets belong to cost-of-living.

poverty.label: poverty
poverty.definition: The extent, characteristics or experience of inadequate resources and material deprivation.
includes: Poverty counts, destitution, deprivation and household living standards explicitly evaluated as poverty.
excludes: Low wages or sparse housing without evidence of deprivation; relief administration alone.

refugees-and-displacement.label: refugees and displacement
refugees-and-displacement.definition: People forced to leave their homes and the circumstances or support of displaced populations.
includes: Refugees, evacuees, internally displaced people, resettlement and relief following forced movement.
excludes: Voluntary migration or ordinary settler schemes without evidence of forced displacement.

charitable-institutions.label: charitable institutions
charitable-institutions.definition: Organizations and establishments providing philanthropic relief or social support.
includes: Charities, relief societies, philanthropic foundations, charitable homes and their beneficiaries or finances.
excludes: Every religious institution; commercial insurance; a hospital or school without an explicit charitable role.

foreign-aid.label: foreign aid
foreign-aid.definition: Assistance supplied across national boundaries for relief, social support or recovery.
includes: Foreign relief grants, donated supplies, international humanitarian assistance and aid programmes.
excludes: Commercial foreign loans or investment; ordinary diplomatic expenses; domestic relief without foreign assistance.

work-relief.label: work relief
work-relief.definition: Employment or public works organized primarily to provide relief to people lacking income or work.
includes: Relief work, assistance through employment, relief-work participants and related expenditure.
excludes: Ordinary infrastructure projects or job placement without a relief purpose.

veterans-and-military-families.label: veterans and military families
veterans-and-military-families.definition: The circumstances, benefits and support of former service members and military dependants.
includes: Veterans’ relief, disabled service members, war bereaved, military-family assistance and related pensions.
excludes: Serving troop strength or military recruitment; general pensions without a veteran or military-family population.

youth-organisations.label: youth organisations
youth-organisations.definition: Organized associations for the development, service, training or support of young people.
includes: Youth associations, youth groups, scouts and membership or activities of youth organizations.
excludes: School enrolment, military recruitment or juvenile justice without an association as the subject.

tags.label: banditry
tags.definition: Armed robbery and raiding by groups described by the source as bandits, and official campaigns directed against them.
includes: Bandit groups, raids, surrender, seized weapons, damage and suppression outcomes.
Retain the source’s bandit classification as a reported category; establish political purpose separately.
excludes: Ordinary theft without armed-group activity; interstate war; automatically reclassifying all insurgents or independence movements as criminals.

tags.label: addiction treatment
tags.definition: Medical or organized services intended to treat narcotic dependence and support recovery.
includes: Narcotic treatment stations, patients receiving addiction care, detoxification and treatment outcomes.
excludes: Drug-user or licensed-smoker counts without treatment; seizures and suppression without a care programme; general hospital activity without addiction care.
